name: Kingfisher Starter Reference
description: Recent elite broadcast games, including online events, bundled with Kingfisher so the opening explorer, player search and model games work before anything is installed or imported.

provenance.transformation: Games were parsed, filtered by rating and length, deduplicated, replayed through Kingfisher's own rules code, and reduced to per-position move aggregates, a player table and full game scores. No move was altered.
